brief:
Moshe Feiglin, an Israeli politician, described the entire population of Gaza as the "enemy," including babies and children, according to remarks he made in an interview with the Jerusalem Post, Middle East Eye reported. Feiglin did not distinguish between civilians and combatants in his characterization of Gazans.

The statement reflects rhetoric that has circulated among some Israeli officials and commentators during the ongoing conflict in Gaza.
dek: Israeli politician calls Gaza's population, including babies, the 'enemy' Israeli politician Moshe Feiglin said that the entire population in Gaza, including babies and children, are the "enemy" during an interview with the Jerusalem Post.
title: Israeli politician calls all Gazans, including babies, the enemy
